# ui::SpellingError

Header: `winui/render/SpellChecker.hpp`.

One finding of [SpellChecker::check()](spell-checker.md#check): a range of the checked text and what to do about it.

Example: 
```cpp
void autocorrect(ui::SpellChecker& checker, std::string& text)
{
    for (const ui::SpellingError& e : checker.check(text))
    {
        if (e.action == ui::SpellingAction::Replace && checker.autocorrect_enabled())
        {
            text.replace(e.start, e.length, e.replacement);
            break; // offsets after this one are stale now
        }
    }
}
```

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `start` | `std::size_t` | `0` | Offset of the range in the checked text. |
| `length` | `std::size_t` | `0` | Length of the range. |
| `action` | `SpellingAction` | `SpellingAction::Suggest` | What the checker suggests doing. |
| `replacement` | `std::string` |  | The correction; valid only for SpellingAction::Replace. |
